title: emilkowalski/skills
notes: One of the references that shaped Scout — its find-animation-opportunities gate (closed enums, mandatory rejected-candidates section, hard cap, "nothing surfaced is a good result") is the template for Scout's surfacing pipeline. Skills-collection meta-entry: the install copies prompt documents, not code. Flat layout, no plugin manifest — skills.sh is the only documented distribution.
summary: Emil Kowalski's collection of six design-engineering skills — animation review against strict rules, codebase audits for motion opportunities, an animation vocabulary for talking to models, and Apple-derived interface principles — in a flat skills/<name>/SKILL.md layout distributed via skills.sh only. The product is Emil's taste encoded as gates and rules: "Agents don't have great taste"; this collection is the corrective.
surfaces_when: auditing a UI codebase for animation and motion-polish opportunities
reviewing or refining existing UI animations — easing, duration, transform and shadow choices
a plan adds motion to components (modals, toasts, menus, page transitions) and needs taste-level rules rather than more code
ambient_line: emilkowalski/skills — Emil's design-engineering skills; reach for animation and UI-polish passes.
